resources.string: Office files cannot be shown safely inside the vault. Open the file with another app on purpose if you need it.
There is no view for this kind of file. You can open it with another app on purpose.
Too large to view (at most %1$d MB are decrypted in memory). You can open it with another app on purpose.
This file cannot be decrypted with the keys of this device.
Not enough free space for the encrypted video.
This device cannot keep the file in memory only.

The other app gets the content unencrypted. What it keeps of it (history, previews, copies) is no longer protected by the vault. GateControl itself writes no unencrypted file and withdraws the file as soon as you come back or the vault locks.
Too large for another app (at most %1$d MB).
